properties.name: Forensic Method
properties.description: Reconstructs events methodically from physical evidence, records and testimony.

properties.name: Institutional Standing
properties.description: Holds official rank as an inspector inside a closed, controlled city; that rank opens records, doors and cooperation.

properties.name: Standing Boundary
properties.description: Her authority exists only inside the city's institutions; beyond them it carries no weight.

properties.name: Artificial Companions
properties.description: Works among artificial humans and comes to treat one as a companion rather than a tool.

properties.name: Guarded Composure
properties.description: Proud, controlled and unreadable under pressure.

properties.name: Sidearm Competence
properties.description: Capable with a handgun when an investigation turns violent.
